panels.title: Local capacity
panels.description: Physically attached disks. Network and virtual devices are counted separately.

targets.expr: sum(max by (device) (talos_block_disk_size_bytes{node="$node"}) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_disk_info{node="$node", attachment="local"}))
count(talos_block_disk_info{node="$node", attachment="local"}) or vector(0)
count(talos_block_disk_info{node="$node", attachment="network"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fullest filesystem
panels.description: The tightest mount on the node — nearly always /var, which stops the kubelet when it fills.

targets.expr: max(max by (mountpoint) (talos_filesystem_used_bytes{node="$node"}) / max by (mountpoint) (talos_filesystem_size_bytes{node="$node"})) * 100

panels.title: Read
panels.description: Bytes read from all block devices, rated over the selected window.

targets.expr: sum(max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_read_bytes_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"}))

panels.title: Write
panels.description: Bytes written to all block devices.

targets.expr: sum(max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_written_bytes_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"}))

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests issued and not yet completed. A number that will not fall is a device not keeping up.

targets.expr: sum(max by (device) (talos_block_io_now{node="$node"}) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"}))

panels.title: Volumes
panels.description: Talos volumes that did not reach their ready phase.

targets.expr: max(talos_machine_volumes_not_ready{node="$node"})
count(max by (volume) (talos_machine_volume_ready{node="$node"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Block I/O over the selected window
Throughput
panels.description: Read above the axis, write below, one pair per whole disk. Partitions report the same traffic and are excluded.

targets.expr: max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_read_bytes_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})
- max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_written_bytes_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})

panels.title: IOPS
panels.description: Completed operations per second. Throughput divided by IOPS is the average request size.

targets.expr: max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_reads_completed_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})
- max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_writes_completed_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})

panels.title: Utilisation
panels.description: Share of time the device had a request in flight. On NVMe, queue depth is the better saturation signal.

targets.expr: max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_time_seconds_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"}) * 100

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Mean requests in flight. This is what tells you an NVMe device is saturated.

targets.expr: max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_time_weighted_seconds_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Average service time per request.

targets.expr: max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_read_time_seconds_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"}) / clamp_min(max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_reads_completed_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"}), 1)

max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_write_time_seconds_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"}) / clamp_min(max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_writes_completed_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"}), 1)

panels.title: Merges
panels.description: Requests the kernel combined before issuing. A high rate means the workload is sequential.

targets.expr: max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_reads_merged_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})
max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_writes_merged_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})

panels.title: Discards (TRIM)
panels.description: Blocks released back to the SSD. Flat at zero means nothing is trimming.

targets.expr: max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_discards_completed_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})
max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_discarded_bytes_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})
max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_discards_merged_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})
max by (device) (rate(talos_block_io_discard_time_seconds_total{node="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})

panels.title: In flight now
panels.description: Outstanding requests per disk, right now.

targets.expr: max by (device) (talos_block_io_now{node="$node"}) * on (device) group_left () max by (device) (talos_block_io_info{node="$node", kind="disk"})

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: Every block device. `local` is this machine's hardware, `network` is iSCSI, the rest are loop or device-mapper.

targets.expr: max by (device, model, serial, transport, attachment, wwid, bus_path) (talos_block_disk_info{node="$node"})
max by (device) (talos_block_disk_size_bytes{node="$node"})
max by (device) (talos_block_disk_sector_size_bytes{node="$node"})
max by (device) (talos_block_disk_rotational{node="$node"})
max by (device) (talos_block_disk_readonly{node="$node"})
max by (device) (talos_block_disk_cdrom{node="$node"})

label_replace(label_replace(max by (dev_path) (talos_system_disk_info{node="$node"}), "device", "$1", "dev_path", "(.*)"), "dev_path", "", "", "") or ((max by (device) (talos_block_disk_size_bytes{node="$node"}) * 0 + 0) unless on (device) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (dev_path) (talos_system_disk_info{node="$node"}), "device", "$1", "dev_path", "(.*)"), "dev_path", "", "", "")))

panels.title: PersistentVolumes on this node
panels.description: PersistentVolumes mounted on this node. Requested is what the PVC asked for; Size is what the filesystem reports.

targets.expr: max by (pv, device, filesystem) (talos_volume_info{node="$node"})
max by (pv) (talos_volume_size_bytes{node="$node"})
max by (pv) (talos_volume_used_bytes{node="$node"})
max by (pv) (talos_volume_available_bytes{node="$node"})

max by (pv, claim, namespace, storageclass) (talos_pv_info) and on (pv) max by (pv) (talos_volume_info{node="$node"}) or ((max by (pv) (talos_volume_size_bytes{node="$node"}) * 0 + -1) unless on (pv) (max by (pv, claim, namespace, storageclass) (talos_pv_info) and on (pv) max by (pv) (talos_volume_info{node="$node"})))

max by (pv) (talos_pv_capacity_bytes) and on (pv) max by (pv) (talos_volume_info{node="$node"}) or ((max by (pv) (talos_volume_size_bytes{node="$node"}) * 0 + -1) unless on (pv) (max by (pv) (talos_pv_capacity_bytes) and on (pv) max by (pv) (talos_volume_info{node="$node"})))
max by (pv) (talos_volume_used_bytes{node="$node"}) / max by (pv) (talos_volume_size_bytes{node="$node"}) * 100

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: The node's own filesystems. Used plus available is less than size — ext4 and xfs reserve a slice for root.

targets.expr: max by (mountpoint, device) (talos_filesystem_info{node="$node"})
max by (mountpoint) (talos_filesystem_size_bytes{node="$node"})
max by (mountpoint) (talos_filesystem_used_bytes{node="$node"})
max by (mountpoint) (talos_filesystem_available_bytes{node="$node"})
max by (mountpoint) (talos_filesystem_used_bytes{node="$node"}) / max by (mountpoint) (talos_filesystem_size_bytes{node="$node"}) * 100

panels.title: Talos volumes
panels.description: Talos's volume layer. A volume short of `ready` on an encrypted node is one that did not unlock.

targets.expr: max by (volume, type, phase, filesystem, location) (talos_machine_volume_info{node="$node"})
max by (volume) (talos_machine_volume_ready{node="$node"})

max by (volume) (talos_machine_volume_capacity_bytes{node="$node"}) or ((max by (volume) (talos_machine_volume_ready{node="$node"}) * 0 + -1) unless on (volume) (max by (volume) (talos_machine_volume_capacity_bytes{node="$node"})))

max by (volume, provider) (talos_machine_volume_encrypted{node="$node"}) or ((max by (volume) (talos_machine_volume_ready{node="$node"}) * 0 + -1) unless on (volume) (max by (volume, provider) (talos_machine_volume_encrypted{node="$node"})))

max by (volume) (talos_machine_volume_encryption_failed_syncs{node="$node"}) or ((max by (volume) (talos_machine_volume_ready{node="$node"}) * 0 + -1) unless on (volume) (max by (volume) (talos_machine_volume_encryption_failed_syncs{node="$node"})))

panels.title: Mounts
panels.description: Where each Talos volume landed. Project quota is what enforces per-pod ephemeral-storage limits.

targets.expr: max by (volume, source, target, filesystem) (talos_mount_info{node="$node"})
max by (volume) (talos_mount_read_only{node="$node"})
max by (volume) (talos_mount_project_quota_supported{node="$node"})

panels.title: Volume errors
panels.description: Why a volume is not ready, in Talos's words. No series at all on a healthy node.

targets.expr: max by (volume, error) (talos_machine_volume_error_info{node="$node"})

list.label: Node
list.description: Which node this page is about; the UI's node switcher.
